course.title: Unit 4 Healthy habits-Part B--【例句】
course.description: Part B（How can good habits help us?）

sentences.content: Can I watch a TV show now, please?
sentences.english: Can I watch a TV show now , please ?
sentences.chinese: 请问我现在可以看个电视节目吗？

sentences.content: Can I play on Mum's phone?
sentences.english: Can I play on Mum's phone ?
sentences.chinese: 我可以玩妈妈的手机吗？

sentences.content: No. You shouldn't play on a phone so often.
sentences.english: No . You shouldn't play on a phone so often
sentences.chinese: 不，你不该这么频繁地玩手机。
你应该让眼睛休息一下。

sentences.content: OK. Let's play in the garden then.
sentences.english: OK . Let's play in the garden then
sentences.chinese: 好的，那我们去花园玩吧。

sentences.content: Don't check your phone in bed.
sentences.english: Don't check your phone in bed

sentences.chinese: 你应该让眼睛休息一下。

sentences.content: You should brush your teeth twice a day.
sentences.english: You should brush your teeth twice a day

sentences.content: How can I take care of our teeth?
sentences.english: How can I take care of our teeth ?
sentences.chinese: 我该如何护理我们的牙齿？

wordDetails.definition: take care of（短语动词）: 照顾

sentences.content: I like hamburgers and ice cream.
sentences.english: I like hamburgers and ice cream

sentences.content: I don't often eat green vegetables.
sentences.english: I don't often eat green vegetables

sentences.content: Yes. I have PE every day from Monday to Friday, but I don't do sports at the weekend.
sentences.english: Yes . I have PE every day from Monday to Friday , but I don't do sports at the weekend
sentences.chinese: 是的。我从周一到周五每天都有体育课，但周末不运动。

sentences.content: How many hours do you sleep every day?
sentences.english: How many hours do you sleep every day ?

sentences.content: I usually sleep about eight hours a day, but sometimes I only sleep six hours.
sentences.english: I usually sleep about eight hours a day , but sometimes I only sleep six hours
sentences.chinese: 我通常每天睡八小时左右，但有时只睡六小时。

sentences.content: How do you usually spend your free time?
sentences.english: How do you usually spend your free time ?
sentences.chinese: 你平时空闲时间都做些什么？

sentences.content: I like watching TV, but I don't spend too much time on it.
sentences.english: I like watching TV , but I don't spend too much time on it
sentences.chinese: 我喜欢看电视，但不会花太多时间在上面。

sentences.content: Do you often play with your friends?
sentences.english: Do you often play with your friends ?
sentences.chinese: 你经常和朋友一起玩吗？

sentences.content: Yes. I play with my friends every day.
sentences.english: Yes . I play with my friends every day
sentences.chinese: 是的。我每天都和朋友们一起玩。
